items.title: Infantino proposes an ‘independent external review’ of Fifa governance
items.summary: President writes to council and member nations Infantino says he is ‘fully committed to leading Fifa’ The Fifa president, Gianni Infantino, has agreed to commission an independent governance review after coming under mounting pressure to do so in the wake of the World Cup sale debacle. The Guardian revealed last month that several members of the Fifa council had been lobbying for an external review of both the proposed Fifa Forward Enterprise sell-off and the Folarin Balogun controversy – with the Football Association chair, Debbie Hewitt, increasing the pressure last week by writing to Infantino demanding the release of all documents relating to both issues. Continue reading...

items.title: Come back soon Premier League, the endlessly moreish mega-product | Barney Ronay
items.summary: Brighton have impressed in a goal-laden start to the season, in a league that remains a brutally strong attraction Get ready for the dopamine crash. And this one really is a proper autumn nosedive. The past 17 days up to and including Sunday’s cut-off gave us 30 Premier League games and 79 goals. Which, if you take Spurs out of it – and this is fair because Spurs are now post‑goal, an entertainment concept unrelated to goals or even football itself – is really quite a lot. Are your pathways stimulated? Are the neural connectors flickering? Well get ready for cold turkey, for 19 blank days of shivers and shakes until the Premier League show resumes in October. Maybe it really is time to buy one of those powders off the internet. Continue reading...

items.title: The last two seasons were grim for Spurs. This is as bad as it’s ever been | Jonathan Wilson
items.summary: Pre-season thoughts of European qualification are already beginning to look bafflingly optimistic for Roberto De Zerbi’s team Sign up for our free newsletter here In March, Tottenham, fearing possible relegation, spent big to bring in Roberto De Zerbi, who will probably never go into a negotiation with a stronger hand. There was obvious improvement and they stayed up on the final day of the season. Since then, Spurs have spent a net £175m ($234m) on improving the squad. The message seemed clear: the fiscal caution of the Daniel Levy era was over and this was a club willing to spend. Yet Spurs go into the first international break bottom of the Premier League table. To an extent, the issue is confidence. On the opening weekend at Brentford, with a weird mishmash of a side, a team that was clearly undercooked, they were hammered 3-0 by much better-prepared opponents. That was not hugely surprising given how sensible Brentford’s transfer dealing had been and how early they had done it. More worrying was what happened the following week as Spurs, starting well before fading, lost 2-0 at home to Newcastle. Continue reading...

items.title: Thomas Tuchel rocked by five key withdrawals from England squad
items.summary: Palmer, Rice, Mainoo, Rashford and Livramento injured James Garner and Morgan Gibbs-White called-up as cover Thomas Tuchel has been rocked by a host of withdrawals from his England squad, with Cole Palmer, Declan Rice, Kobbie Mainoo, Marcus Rashford and Tino Livramento all out because of injury. The head coach has called up James Garner and Morgan Gibbs‑White to boost his options for the upcoming Nations League programme. Tuchel gave Palmer a high-profile recall on Friday for the beginning of the two-year international cycle that he hopes will end in glory at Euro 2028. England are back in the top division of the Nations League and they kick off against Spain at Wembley on Saturday. They then play Czechia and Croatia away before returning to Wembley to face Czechia. Continue reading...

items.title: Granit Xhaka admits to receiving fake Covid vaccination certificate in 2022
items.summary: Sunderland captain withdrawn from Switzerland squad He will be questioned by prosecutor’s office in Lucerne Granit Xhaka has been withdrawn from Switzerland’s squad after he admitted receiving a fake Covid vaccination certificate in 2022. The Sunderland and Switzerland captain – who was an Arsenal player at the time – has apologised for this “mistake” and will sit out his country’s forthcoming four Nations League matches. Xhaka is poised to be questioned by the prosecutor’s office in Lucerne next week as it decides whether any criminal proceedings will be initiated regarding the alleged issue of a series of false Covid certificates by a doctor based in the Swiss city during the pandemic. The doctor, who was first investigated in 2023, has denied the allegations. Continue reading...

items.title: Sans surprise, l'Espagne prolonge son sélectionneur après le titre mondial
items.summary: Luis De La Fuente, vainqueur de l'Euro 2024 et de la Coupe du Monde 2026, restera le sélectionneur de l'Espagne un peu plus longtemps. Et même en réalité beaucoup plus longtemps, puisque la fédération espagnole lui a offert un contrat longue durée jusqu'en 2032 !

items.title: Grote verandering op komst? Infantino stuurt brief naar alle FIFA-landen

items.title: Trop longtemps humiliée, l'Italie de Roberto Mancini "veut gagner", et ça commence face aux Diables Rouges
items.summary: La Squadra Azzurra démarre elle aussi un nouveau cycle, et elle part de plus loin que la Belgique. Car même si elle a remporté l'Euro 2021, ce qui n'était pas il y a si longtemps, l'Italie a depuis manqué deux Coupes du Monde et vécu un véritable raz-de-marée interne en 2026. Roberto Mancini veut et doit redresser la barre : cela commencera ce vendredi.

items.title: Van grote hoop bij Anderlecht naar lange lijdensweg: nu is er eindelijk beterschap
items.summary: César Huerta probeert zijn carrière opnieuw op de rails te krijgen na een bijzonder moeilijke periode bij Anderlecht. De Mexicaan keerde terug naar Pumas UNAM en maakte daar eindelijk weer minuten, nadat blessures en een gebrek aan perspectief zijn Brusselse avontuur hadden gefnuikt.

items.title: Tom Caluwé ontleedt drukke transferzomer en mislukte seizoensstart van KV Mechelen
items.summary: KV Mechelen beleeft een bijzonder moeilijke start van het nieuwe seizoen. Malinwa pakte amper drie punten uit de eerste zeven competitiewedstrijden en wacht nog altijd op zijn eerste overwinning. Volgens sportief directeur Tom Caluwé speelt de voorbije transferzomer daarin een duidelijke rol. De kern was bij de start van de competitie nog volop in beweging.

items.title: Club Brugge, Anderlecht en Union domineren na sterke speeldag

items.title: "Il n'a pas respecté nos accords" : Stijnen explique la sanction de Nainggolan... dans leur podcast commun
items.summary: Ce week-end, Radja Nainggolan a été mis à l'écart par Stijn Stijnen, entraîneur du Patro Eisden. Ce dernier a justifié cette décision par "plusieurs raisons", sans donner plus de détails. Mais les deux hommes sont consultants hebdomadaires dans le même podcast en Flandre, Ongefilterd, et sont donc revenus sur le sujet.

items.title: Hein Vanhaezebrouck is onder de indruk van JPL-spits: "Dat is fenomenaal"
items.summary: Union SG blijft verbazen, ook nu opnieuw enkele belangrijke pionnen verdwenen zijn. Hein Vanhaezebrouck dacht dat vooral het vertrek van Christian Burgess zwaar zou doorwegen, maar ziet dat de Brusselaars ook dat probleem alweer hebben opgelost. Voor hem is het stilaan geen verrassing meer dat er telkens nieuwe spelers opstaan.

items.title: Tous les clubs belges n'ont pas la gâchette facile : un coach soutenu officiellement malgré son bilan
items.summary: Le premier coach de Jupiler Pro League à prendre la porte cette saison aura été Michiel Jonckheere suite au début de saison très compliqué du KV Courtrai. Et il faudra encore attendre un peu avant de connaître la prochaine victime du jeu de chaises musicales dans notre championnat, car le KV Malines, de son côté, a confirmé Fred Vanderbiest dans ses fonctions.

items.title: De retour au Mexique, César Huerta voit le bout du tunnel, son coach s'exprime sur ses débuts
items.summary: Parti cet été d'Anderlecht après un véritable calvaire européen, César Huerta est rentré au Mexique. Il a disputé ses premières minutes cette saison avec les Pumas UNAM. Son coach a expliqué pourquoi il prenait son temps avec l'international mexicain.
